name: from_raw_parts_mut
declaration: const unsafe fn from_raw_parts_mut < 'a > (ptr : * mut u8 , len : usize) -> & 'a mut str
documentation:
Creates a `&mut str` from a pointer and a length.

 The pointed-to bytes must be valid UTF-8.
 If this might not be the case, use `str::from_utf8_mut(slice::from_raw_parts_mut(ptr, len))`,
 which will return an `Err` if the data isn't valid UTF-8.

 This function is the `str` equivalent of [`slice::from_raw_parts_mut`](crate::slice::from_raw_parts_mut).
 See that function's documentation for safety concerns and examples.

 The immutable version of this function is [`from_raw_parts`].
rules: The `len` bytes pointed to by `ptr` must be valid UTF-8.
`ptr` must be non-null and properly aligned, even when `len` is zero.
`ptr` must be valid for both reads and writes for `len` bytes.
The entire `len`-byte memory range starting at `ptr` must be contained within a single allocated object.
`ptr` must point to `len` consecutive properly initialized `u8` values.
For the duration of the returned reference's lifetime `'a`, the referenced memory must not be read or written through any pointer not derived from the returned reference.
`len` bytes must be no larger than `isize::MAX` bytes.
Adding `len` bytes to `ptr` must not wrap around the address space.
